assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-197.
